# Stellaris Star

Stellaris Star provides China company registration and corporate secretarial coordination for foreign founders.

## Localized brand promise
- English: Affordable online setup. Real local support.
- Korean: 부담을 낮춘 온라인 설립, 필요할 때 이어지는 중국 현지 지원.
- Arabic: تأسيس إلكتروني ميسور ودعم محلي حقيقي عند الحاجة.
- Russian: Доступный онлайн-старт и реальная местная поддержка.


## Final public offer
- Standard China company-registration service fee: US$99.
- Included standard scope: online eligibility assessment, digital information collection, basic company-name assistance, standard business-scope and registration-document preparation, filing coordination, progress updates and English-language customer support.
- US$99 is not an all-inclusive China setup price. Registered address, government and third-party fees, translation or authentication, licences, tax and accounting, banking, immigration, trademark and sourcing services are quoted separately when required.
- Registration, bank accounts, licences, visas, work permits and residence permits are never guaranteed.

## Core value
- Online application with a clear checklist and progress route.
- Real local human support for complex cases.
- Optional connections to accounting, banking, immigration, suppliers and professional services.
- WhatsApp enquiries acknowledged within 30 minutes during Mon–Fri, 09:00–18:00 China time (UTC+8).

## Market research and local negotiation support
- Local China market research and negotiation support are separate commercial services for overseas buyers and founders.
- Scope may include competitor and supplier mapping, supplier outreach in Chinese, quotation comparison, MOQ, lead-time and payment-term checks, meeting or visit coordination, commercial negotiation support and a written findings or decision record.
- Coordination pricing starts from US$200 per standard container shipment, or 1.5% of the goods value. The applicable model, deliverables and payment point must be agreed in writing before work begins; the two models are not automatically combined.
- Market research and broader advisory projects are quoted after a written brief.
- Goods, samples, inspection or testing, travel, freight, insurance, customs, duties, taxes and third-party fees are separate. Stellaris Star does not guarantee the lowest price, supplier performance, product quality, shipment, customs clearance or transaction outcome.
- The buyer remains responsible for supplier due diligence, samples, inspection, testing, contracts, payment, logistics, destination-market requirements and the final purchasing decision.

## Commercial negotiation terms (2026-08-14)
- Local supplier mapping, Chinese-language outreach, quotation comparison and commercial negotiation are available as a separately scoped service.
- Fee models: from US$200 per standard container shipment OR 1.5% of goods value; the applicable model is agreed in writing and they are not automatically combined.
- When the written proposal expressly provides it, Stellaris Star's negotiation service fee is payable after the client signs the supplier contract. Supplier deposits, goods and third-party charges remain due under their own contracts.
- The team targets a 10–15% reduction in total negotiated contract cost versus the supplier's documented pre-negotiation quotation or another baseline agreed in writing. Savings and contract outcomes are not guaranteed.
- Canonical service pages: https://stesstar.com/en/commercial-negotiation/ and localized equivalents in Korean, Arabic and Russian.
